meta_description:
210K likes, 5,255 comments - shenaztreasury on September 9, 2026: "Share and use this. This website is Nammakasa and in bangalore only for now but this is such a great idea, we should make apps like this for every city town and village in India 🇮🇳 www.nammakasa.in/

If you have friends who can make apps, send them this and ask them to make one for your town/city! 

Tumne Fekha, Maine Dekha. 

If people litter, we document it.
If garbage is lying around, we report it.
If nobody cleans it, we keep asking why.

I really think EVERY Indian city needs something like this.

Mumbai, can we please have our version?

Because I’m done accepting that our streets are just supposed to be garbage dumps w rats 🐀 running around. 

I’m done seeing people spit everywhere. 

Take a photo 
Of the person
Of the garbage and report it! 

Make videos of people who litter 
Shame them
That’s the only way #tumnefekhamainedekha".
